title: Fixed Pedestal and Opposed Reach Arm Machine
description: One newly authored complete fixed pedestal spot-contact-machine-style exterior. A full tall tapered machine cabinet and broad ground foot carry a low forward cylindrical arm ending in an upward blunt contact nose. A separate complete upper reach arm is fixed at a visible rear fork and transverse axle, with its front blunt nose facing down across a real open gap. One whole side operating-style lever and grip share that rear pivot. A fixed broad foot pedal, rooted lower fork and attached short linkage belong to the same ground base; a blank front panel and one knob are subordinate exterior details. Unlike the old C-casting rack press, there is no surrounding C frame, vertical toothed ram or anvil bed; unlike the soldering station there is no handheld iron or coil rest. All whole geometry newly authored, not old equipment with a replacement tip. Three opaque PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Empty fixed art appearance only: no workpiece, current path, powered heat, welding, clamping force, pedal actuation, electrical enclosure rating, installation, operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
